title: M2C protocol v1 shared definitions
description: Definitions referenced by the envelope and the payload schemas. Nothing here is a message on its own.

uuid.description: Lower-case canonical UUID, minted by the sender of the message.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time with an explicit offset.

run_id.description: Opaque run identifier. Minted by the client in run.start (a UUID or ULID is recommended); the server validates it, scopes it to the device's user, and rejects a collision with invalid_message. Never parse it.

call_id.description: Identifier of one tool call, minted by the server in tool_proposed. Duplicate results for the same call_id are ignored.

risk.description: R0 read-only, R1 write inside project, R2 run command, R3 network or outside project, R4 irreversible or external effect.

profile.description: O8: every run carries its profile. Further profiles (Menux's) are added to this list additively.

mode.description: Permission mode the run starts in. The device's policy engine stays authoritative; the server uses the mode to decide which tools the model may see (plan mode: read-only tools plus plan_exit).

error_code.description: Stable strings. Clients treat an unknown code as internal.

run_state.description: Run state machine: created -> running <-> awaiting_approval -> completed, plus paused_budget, paused_disconnected, paused_error, cancelled, failed, expired. Terminal: completed, cancelled, failed, expired.

trust.description: Where a tool result came from, so the policy engine can taint the session.

tool_name.description: A v0 catalog name, or a later-catalog / MCP name such as mcp__server__tool.

tool_catalog_version.description: Which set of tool schemas the client can execute (protocol/v1/tools).

cwd_label.description: A human label for the working directory, for example the project's folder name. NEVER a path: separators and control characters are rejected.

model_pref.description: Opaque model preference, for example auto. The server maps it, and tells the user through a notice when it cannot honour it; it never downgrades silently.

bulk_text.description: Content carried only in flight. v1 ceiling of 200000 characters; welcome.limits may announce a lower one.
